title: Marginal Labels

illustrates.quote: Labels printed in the margin can be intrusive in braille and great care needs to be taken to not interrupt the flow of text any more than necessary. List the labels in a key before the text.

Although some people might prefer watching TV or napping, for me swimming is the best way to relax. First of all, swimming quiets my mind. After a few laps, all the day's worries just drain out of me. In addition, swimming energizes me. The deep breathing sends more oxygen to my brain and muscles. Afterwards, I'm wide awake and refreshed. If I have homework to do, I can concentrate better on it. Furthermore, I'm never sore after swimming, as I sometimes am after running and other kinds of exercise. Some people might say that swimming laps is boring because you're not really going anywhere, but for me it's a path to feeling good.
